name: Strapi Self-Hosted
description: Strapi Self-Hosted is an open-source headless CMS that generates Content APIs from custom collection and single types. It supports documents, components, dynamic zones, media, relations, localization, Draft & Publish, users, roles, API tokens, plugins, releases, REST, GraphQL, and administrative APIs.
agentUseSummary: Relay calls one Strapi 5 collection type's findOne route for a preselected documentId, fixes status to published, requests only lifecycle timestamps, and returns only document ID and those timestamps. Relay requires a dedicated expiring custom API token with only findOne permission on that content type and blocks lists, arbitrary fields, population, drafts, other content types, uploads, administration, and mutations.

capabilities.label: Read selected document lifecycle
capabilities.description: Read one selected published document's ID and lifecycle timestamps.

allowed.label: Read selected document lifecycle
allowed.description: Use one Strapi 5 findOne route for the selected published document and return only document ID and lifecycle timestamps.

blocked.label: Expose content or identities
blocked.description: Titles, slugs, bodies, custom fields, components, dynamic zones, media, relations, locales, users, and identities are excluded from Relay output.

blocked.label: Mutate Strapi
blocked.description: Documents, content types, components, media, users, roles, tokens, settings, plugins, releases, drafts, and every create, update, delete, publish, or unpublish action are blocked.

blocked.label: Use broad Strapi access
blocked.description: Document lists, other document IDs, other content types, arbitrary fields, filters, population, drafts, locales, GraphQL, uploads, custom routes, redirects, and administration are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Selected Document Lifecycle Read
approvalProfiles.description: Read one selected published document's lifecycle projection; content, identities, other resources, administration, drafts, and mutations remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Mount one no-input selected-document lifecycle reader backed by Railway's bounded Strapi adapter.
Mount one no-input selected-document lifecycle reader backed by Railway's bounded Strapi adapter.

providerSetup.blocker: An authorized public HTTPS Strapi 5 staging project must provide a dedicated expiring custom API token whose only permission is findOne for one selected collection type, one published documentId, and Fairfax validation.
providerSetup.nextAction: In the provider-console lane, create the expiring custom findOne-only token, enter the project URL, content-type plural route, and documentId through Relay, then validate exact-document binding, published-only and fixed-field enforcement, output redaction, list/draft/other-route and mutation denial, redirect and private-DNS denial, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial in Fairfax.

evidence.supports: Official Strapi 5 REST documentation defines collection-type findOne routes addressed by documentId, flattened response data, system lifecycle fields, and adjacent CRUD operations.
Official REST parameter documentation defines fields array selection and non-population by default, supporting Relay's fixed lifecycle-only projection.
Official status documentation defines published and draft document variants and the status parameter, supporting Relay's fixed published-only request.

Official API token documentation defines bearer authentication, custom per-content-type permissions, token duration, read-only and full-access alternatives, and one-time token display, supporting Relay's expiring custom findOne-only requirement.
